entries.dialogueText: Chairwoman of the Central Bank of Sordland Edith Agnoc entered the court room nonchalantly and took her seat.

entries.dialogueText: “I am here at the request of a person who shall not be named to present this incriminating evidence against the president of Sordland.”

entries.dialogueText: “Does the person who granted you with the rights to present evidence in his or her stead wish to remain anonymous before this court?”

entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Yes, your honor.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, your honor.”

entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The summary of the evidence I have..."
entries.dialogueText: “The summary of the evidence I have provided to the court is as follows.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Mr. President appears to have been..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President appears to have been involved in a bribery scandal with Albin Clavin.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Mr. President appears to have ille..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President appears to have illegally colluded with Albin Clavin.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“There was a very large money trans..."
entries.dialogueText: “There was a very large money transfer from the President's account to Mr. Clavin's.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The timeline of this event coincid..."
entries.dialogueText: “The timeline of this event coincides with the preparation of the new constitutional changes.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Albin Clavin was promised the Vice..."
entries.dialogueText: “Albin Clavin was promised the Vice Presidency in return for the support of the USP's reformist wing.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“A report states that the President..."
entries.dialogueText: “A report states that the President was in cahoots with Frens Ricter during the constitutional reform process."

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“A report states that the President..."
entries.dialogueText: “A report states that the President acted against the best interests of the state in choosing a contractor for a major infrastructure project."

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“A hefty money transfer between the..."
entries.dialogueText: “A hefty money transfer between the accounts of Mr. Rayne and Mr. Ricter is outlined.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“According to the report, President..."
entries.dialogueText: “According to the report, President Rayne contracted Taurus Holding, a company in which Mr. Ricter holds a major share, in order to curry Mr. Ricter's favor during the reform process."

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Mr. Ricter potentially has made mi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Ricter potentially has made millions from this deal.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“There has apparently been a deal b..."
entries.dialogueText: “There has apparently been a deal between Mr. President and Marcel Koronti in Mr. Koronti's villa in Conriat.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Mr. Koronti agreed to use the medi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Koronti agreed to use the media to support the president's rhetoric in exchange for protection against various government policies that could otherwise target his company.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The evidence includes a voice reco..."
entries.dialogueText: “The evidence includes a voice recording by the security personnel in the villa.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The President tipped off Marcel Ko..."
entries.dialogueText: “The President tipped off Marcel Koronti to the ongoing government investigation into him when his links to the Koranelli Cartel were discovered."

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“As a result, any evidence of Mr. K..."
entries.dialogueText: “As a result, any evidence of Mr. Koronti's cartel connections that may have existed was most likely destroyed.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The government privatization progr..."
entries.dialogueText: “The government privatization program was supposed to have opened the shares of the privatized companies to the public.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Instead, a backroom deal was struc..."
entries.dialogueText: “Instead, a backroom deal was struck and these shares were transferred to Marcel Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Instead, a backroom deal was struc..."
entries.dialogueText: “Instead, a backroom deal was struck and these shares were transferred to Walter Tusk.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The government privatization progr..."
entries.dialogueText: “The government privatization program was supposed to have opened the shares of the privatized companies to the public.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The President has procured shares..."
entries.dialogueText: “The President has procured shares from Underhall Construction.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“These shares are the reason Underh..."
entries.dialogueText: “These shares are the reason Underhall was picked as the construction company for the recent government megaproject.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Mr. President and Walter Tusk made..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President and Walter Tusk made a deal to bail out Sordland's businesses. Bribery appears to have been involved."

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The recent tax cuts for large corp..."
entries.dialogueText: “The recent tax cuts for large corporations in Sordland are a direct result of collusion between President Rayne and Walter Tusk."

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Walter Tusk offered a bribe to the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Walter Tusk offered a bribe to the President in order to secure Underhall Construction as a government contractor at a time when Mr. Tusk owned half of the company.”

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci

entries.dialogueText: “This is a very concerning report.”

entries.dialogueText: “This is a very concerning report.”

entries.dialogueText: “This is a very concerning report.”

entries.dialogueText: “This is the end of my summary.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The evidence is well documented an..."
entries.dialogueText: “The evidence is well documented and proven to be the truth according to the files provided by my anonymous client."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: "“Thank you for presenting the evide..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for presenting the evidence, Mrs. Agnoc. You may leave the room.”

entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for presenting the evidence, Mrs. Agnoc. You may leave the room.”

entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for presenting the evidence, Mrs. Agnoc. You may leave the room.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pulled out a very large stack o..."
entries.dialogueText: She pulled out a very large stack of papers that she could barely carry and put it on the table with a loud thud.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Edith collected her belongings and..."
entries.dialogueText: Edith collected her belongings and left the courtroom, not looking back at me as she did so.

entries.dialogueText: She whispered to me quietly from the table opposite mine.

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“I'm sorry, Anton. I really am. But..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sorry, Anton. I really am. But I'm just the messenger.”

entries.dialogueText: “Screw you, Edith.”

entries.dialogueText: I did not reply to her.

entries.dialogueText: She turned her attention to the papers in front of her.
